reasoning: The long-distance silhouette depends on a gabled roof, elevated mail body, single post, triangular braces, and stepped stone foot.
The front slot, Ravenpost relief, rear shutter, side badges, roof courses, gold trim, and collar hardware are separate identity systems.
Seven admitted views expose enough of the underside, sides, and rear for a complete low-poly volume.

specDepthDecision.rationale: A shallow house-on-post blockout would miss the slot depth, Ravenpost identity, rear construction, roof rhythm, and service-scale grounding.

definitionOfDone: Match the accepted 1.65 by 1.05 by 2.9 yard silhouette and player-relative scale across all admitted views.
Preserve the cobalt gable, timber body, recessed gold mail slot, raven relief, single post, diagonal braces, collar, and two-course stone foot on Low and Ultra.
Ship at or below 1,800 target triangles and never above 3,000 triangles, with two materials, two primitives, zero embedded textures, zero skins, and zero animations.
Expose stable ground, mail-interaction, and unread-effect sockets plus compound collider metadata.

proceduralStrategy: Construct every piece deterministically from boxes, shallow extrusions, and bounded repeated clusters.
Lock floor seating, target bounds, player scale, and the front, side, rear silhouettes before detail.
Keep the true mail slot cavity, roof-course steps, braces, and stone joints as geometry because they affect negative space or grazing response.
Carry surface identity with semantic vertex colors and one shared external atlas, then merge to one opaque and one metal primitive.
Preserve named sockets and collider metadata independently of mesh order.
Optimize only after every critical feature passes at 0.7 or better.

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: Generated studio pixels contain baked light. Shipping intentionally uses vertex colors, semantic roughness scalars, and the repository shared atlas instead of pretending exact PBR extraction.

mustAvoid: albedo reused as roughness or AO
material differences that vanish on Low
judging material only under one studio setup

screenshotReview: dusk cobalt, gold, and raven separation

referenceCamera.note: Match framing by bounds and view label. Do not pixel-fit baked studio shadows.

lightingFromPhoto: Neutral review: broad warm-white key from front-left at elevation 35 degrees, intensity 2.2, with soft shadows.
Fill review: cool hemisphere or broad right fill at intensity 0.8 so slot and eave cavities remain readable without flattening.
Rim review: restrained cool rear-right rim or environment reflection at intensity 0.6 for the roof and post silhouette.
Use ACES-like tone mapping at exposure 1.0, neutral gray background, and a soft ground contact shadow; the asset must also pass dusk and Low without post effects.

actionReadiness.contract: Expose stable semantic pivots, sockets, compound collider intent, and runtime metadata even though the shipping mailbox is static.
authoringRules: The asset root owns whole-object transforms.
Runtime interaction targets Socket_MailInteract, not an anonymous mesh.
Runtime unread state targets Socket_UnreadGlow and is not serialized into the GLB.
Static collision uses the compound proxy and never the visual mesh.
Every child overlap remains gap-free after optimization.
